newsitem.title: USA: AMEX closing averages, index closes higher.
newsitem.headline: AMEX closing averages, index closes higher.

text.p: Prices on the American Stock Exchange closed higher on Wednesday in moderate trading.
The Amex Composite index closed at 556.51, up 1.45 or 0.26 percent.
The most active stock was NTN Communications Inc which closed down 1-13/16 to 2-1/2 on volume of nearly 1.9 million shares.
Winners beat losers 269 to 238, with 178 stocks unchanged.
The average price per share was up $0.05.
Preliminary volume was 19,054,605 compared with 17,498,955 on Tuesday.
